name: Ways of Life
source: You're a young man whose father recently left mysteriously. You need to find out what happened to him, but, in the meantime, you can have fun with girls and even discover your bloodline secrets.​
translation: 你是一个年轻人，他的父亲最近神秘离开了。你需要找出他身上发生了什么事，但与此同时，你可以和女孩们一起玩耍，甚至发现你的血统秘密。​
